mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 2% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 4% indicates a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate indicate a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply indicate an expansionary monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of expansionary monetary policy (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate and a decrease in the inflation rate indicate a robust economy with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
